payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches three load-bearing areas: (1) the Zephyr integration as key unlock — expanded Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and its parent Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture; (2) the thesis-proven claim about async decision capture — expanded Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Obs_TanyaThesisProven, and the full PositioningThesis axis including Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning, Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, and Obs_TanyaAntiSlackQuote; (3) the broader product narrative stack — expanded Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, and Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture so the passes can place this retro in the full problem-solution arc. I also expanded Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (the prior next-sprint focus, which this later retro may update), pricing positions (PricingTier25Plus, PricingTwelveDollars), product category, target market, and webhook architecture — all positions a sprint retro could extend or revise. No area was deliberately excluded; the document is short but its themes span the entire product narrative.
